finite_time_twist.scope: A map satisfying the remainder estimates, not a test of a general existence theorem.

reduction.scope: Energy substitution and the sign of the time-dependent canonical shift.

frequency_targets.scope: Rational approximation to the base frequency, not ratios tending to zero.

limits: Examples check formulas and finite-time estimates. They do not prove the general annulus theorem, minimax multiplicity, normal-form existence or reader comprehension.
